justification: Guards a production writer that rewrites live setback values. Not Critical: no data written by this PR. Not Minor: changes when and what a prod script writes.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: Fails if the script writes without --apply, overwrites a resolved row, or writes without a backup.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Harness hardening plan item 0 (2026-10-31): plain-run writers must back up and need --apply.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Removing the needs_review guard made the resolved-row test fail (1 failed).

pre_impl.existing_data: All 8 rows were resolved on 2026-05-22, so a dry run today should report 0 of 8 still to write.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The old script re-wrote rows regardless of later edits; reviewed_at moved on every run.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new file; pattern copied from scripts/_clean_krg_reversed.py (#1571).
pre_impl.external_source_error: Not applicable: values are in the script, no external source is read.

functions.name: main
functions.what: Dry run by default; with --apply backs up then writes still-open rows only.
functions.input: command line flags and the eight hand-typed rows in UPDATES
functions.output: exit code zero on success, one on a concurrent change
functions.if_none: A row not found or not current is skipped with a message
functions.edge_cases: row resolved since 2026-05-22 is skipped, never overwritten
functions.failure_mode: A concurrent edit makes rowcount 0; the whole run rolls back

break_it.scenario: Someone runs it today without flags
break_it.what_happens: Prints what it would write; writes nothing

break_it.scenario: Someone runs --apply after a row was corrected by hand
break_it.what_happens: That row is skipped as already resolved
break_it.how: needs_review guard on read and in the UPDATE WHERE

break_it.scenario: A row changes between read and write
break_it.how: FOR UPDATE lock plus WHERE needs_review = true
